definitions.explanation: Speaking quietly, at a low volume.

examples.japanese: {小声|こごえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: To speak in a low voice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小声|こごえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please speak quietly in the library.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小声|こごえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: He told me the secret in a whisper.

notes:
{小声|こごえ} is a compound of ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ (small) and ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (voice). It refers to speaking quietly, either to avoid being overheard or out of shyness.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {小声|こごえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to speak in a low voice
- {小声|こごえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say in a whisper
- {小声|こごえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呟|つぶや}く→呟く：05341_tsubuyaku⟧: to mutter under one's breath

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大声|おおごえ}→大声：09592_oogoe⟧: loud voice (opposite)
- ⟦ひそひそ→ひそひそ：06273_hisohiso⟧{声|ごえ}: whispering voice (secretive nuance)
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to lower one's voice (action of reducing volume)

USAGE:
The particle ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ marks {小声|こごえ} as the manner of speaking. Unlike ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧, which describes the action of lowering volume, {小声|こごえ} simply describes the quiet state of one's voice.
